basis: Recorded gaps only. Each is an interval CAIRN was not running and therefore did not observe; none is a claim that nothing happened during it. Gaps whose boundary is "heartbeat" or "ledger-tail" are stated no smaller than they were — see each record. The absence of a gap record evidences coverage only from the first LEDGER_COVERAGE_OPEN onward.
interpretation: No coverage gap is recorded in this window. That means no interval was recorded in which CAIRN was not running — it does not by itself prove continuous coverage, which begins only at the first LEDGER_COVERAGE_OPEN record in the ledger.
